relationship: A line's perpendicular projection onto a plane creates linked right triangles that determine the line-plane angle.

learnerLoop.action: Rotate the floor beam, find the perpendicular projection and complete the linked triangle calculations.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The section triangle, projection and displayed angle update with the beam direction.
learnerLoop.evidence: The 3D model, unfolded right triangles and working checks reveal the true line-plane angle.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Choose the projection direction and trigonometric ratio required for the next calculation.

invariants: The line-plane angle is measured against the line's perpendicular floor projection.
The projection creates right-angle relationships used by the linked triangles.
safeAdaptations: Vary valid 3D dimensions and cable configurations.
Adjust working support while preserving the projection and unfolding sequence.
nonGoals: Measuring the apparent screen angle as the angle between line and plane.

task.description: Current problem statement and supplied quantities.
task.visibility: Shown at the start of each problem or stage.

model.description: Operated construction and its live measurements; see quantities for what is given and revealed.
model.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

working.description: Ordered calculations, learner entries and consequential evidence for the current task.
working.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

completion.description: Achievement, next task or learning transition.
completion.visibility: Shown only when the local completion conditions below are satisfied; representation controls are separately identified.

unfolding.description: Movable blue support card contains the actual unfolding transformation control.
unfolding.visibility: After projection; green cards are used separately for achieved results.

room-offsets.description: Q has given east/north offsets and height relative to floor point P.
room-offsets.output: Room dimensions and the goal supply these lengths.

floor-projection.description: One perpendicular floor projection PR, initially explored through a candidate floor beam and section drop QT.
floor-projection.domain: Floor direction in degrees; lengths in m; true section angle and drop tilt in degrees.
floor-projection.source: Learner rotates/releases the beam until the drop is vertical.
floor-projection.output: The true-section inset distinguishes geometric angle from perspective screen opening.

pr-and-angle.description: PR is reused as adjacent side in the vertical triangle; the final unknown is angle QPR. PR and angle are distinct quantities, while repeated PR labels represent the same segment.
pr-and-angle.domain: Positive length m and angle degrees; sin/cos/tan choice at All.
pr-and-angle.source: Unfolding exposes the connected floor and vertical right triangles; working is shown or entered by level.
pr-and-angle.output: Pythagoras result precedes angle calculation and optional ratio choice.

representation-view.description: Unfold fraction and camera yaw/pitch are view controls, not mathematical answer quantities.
representation-view.source: Learner uses the unfolding slider and later room rotation.
representation-view.output: The same geometry changes representation without changing the certified projection/angle.

modes.none: Beam projection and unfolding are required; Pythagoras and trig working are supplied through staged Continue actions.
modes.some: Enter projection length PR and line–plane angle.
modes.all: Also choose the trig ratio for the vertical right triangle.
modes.perspective: After the calculation, rotate the room to see screen opening change while the true line–plane angle remains fixed.

dependencies: Projection alignment locks the beam before the unfolding support card appears.
Full unfolding precedes projection calculation; verified PR precedes the angle step.
The final perspective test requires a changed screen opening while the calculated angle is fixed.
implementation.completion: Local calcStep/completed state gates the staged cards; final viewCheck is set when the perspective screen opening changes by at least 2.5 degrees from its reference.
limitations: The screen opening is view-dependent and is not an alternative answer to the line–plane angle.
